'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Operation Newcombe]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] announces that it is withdrawing its [[British Armed Forces|troops]] from [[Mali]] citing "political instability" and the controversial relationship between the [[Assimi Goïta]]-led [[military junta]] and [[Russia]]'s [[Wagner Group]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-63627489 (BBC News)]
*[[Kurdish separatism in Iran|Kurdish–Iranian conflict]]
**[[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] (IRGC) strikes the [[headquarters]] of the [[Democratic Party of Iranian Kurdistan]] in [[Koy Sanjaq]], [[Kurdistan Region]], [[Iraq]], with four [[missile]]s, killing at least one person. The IRGC says that it "targeted terrorist groups" with missiles and [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/14/iran-rockets-hit-kurdish-party-hq-in-iraqs-erbil (Al Jazeera)]
*Israeli forces kill a 15-year-old Palestinian girl in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.pagina12.com.ar/497674-la-adolescente-palestina-murio-baleada/ (''Pagina12'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Sixteen people are killed and three others are injured after a road accident in [[Bordj Badji Mokhtar]], [[Algeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/road-accident-algeria-kills-16-including-13-guineans-2022-11-14/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[English Channel migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel migrant crossings]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] and [[France]] sign a revised [[border control]] agreement to stop migrant boats from crossing the [[English Channel]] amid record numbers of migrants making the crossing. The agreement will increase the number of officers patrolling the French coast to 300 and have British [[Law enforcement in the United Kingdom|police officers]] work with their French counterparts in control rooms and on beaches. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-63615653 (BBC News)]
*[[Iran–European Union relations]]
**[[Sanctions against Iran]]
***The [[European Union]] adds 30 Iranian entities including news channel [[Press TV]] and cloud computing service [[Abr Arvan]] to its sanctions blacklist. [https://taz.de/Iranische-Tarnfirmen-in-Deutschland/!5885984/ (Taz)]
*[[Brazil]], the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], and [[Indonesia]], the three [[List of countries by forest area|countries with the largest tropical forest area]], propose a trilateral alliance to collaborate on [[forest protection]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/14/world/rainforest-alliance-brazil-indonesia-congo-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Istanbul bombing]]
**[[Ministry of Interior (Turkey)|Turkish interior minister]] [[Süleyman Soylu]] says that 46 people, including the Syrian woman accused of planting the bomb, have been detained. Süleyman also accuses the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] of being behind the attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/14/turkish-police-arrest-suspect-in-istiklal-bombing (Al Jazeera)]
